01 / SEMANTIC SEARCH↗
arXivSearch_

Papers by meaning, not keywords.

Screenshot coming soon

ArXiv Semantic Search

Full-stack · Search

A full-stack semantic search engine that retrieves arXiv computer-science papers by meaning rather than exact keywords.

  • Next.js
  • TypeScript
  • FastAPI
  • Qdrant
  • ONNX Runtime
  • Docker

ENGINEERING FOCUSSemantic search architecture, vector databases, ML inference optimization, API design, and full-stack integration.

Key features +
  • Queries and paper title + abstract text are embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into 384-dimensional vectors.
  • Qdrant cosine nearest-neighbour search with optional arXiv category filters; ranked results show similarity scores.
  • ONNX Runtime + Hugging Face tokenizers pipeline (tokenize, mean-pool, L2-normalize) instead of the full PyTorch runtime.
  • FastAPI service with typed Pydantic request/response validation, a health endpoint, and OpenAPI/Swagger docs.
  • Responsive Next.js 16 / React 19 frontend with shareable URL state and loading, empty, and error states.
  • Reproducible fetch, embed, index, and verify scripts; Docker Compose local stack; committed sample dataset; pytest suite.
  • Began as a distributed-systems course project on a 3-node Elasticsearch cluster; the current version moved to Qdrant so it can run on a lightweight host.

DocuMind

Full-stack · AI

A full-stack AI documentation assistant with multi-provider LLM chat, streaming responses, persistent conversations, authentication, and media uploads.

  • Next.js
  • TypeScript
  • Express
  • MongoDB
  • Vercel AI SDK
  • AWS S3

ENGINEERING FOCUSMulti-provider AI integration, streaming APIs, authentication, persistent chat architecture, and cloud file storage.

Key features +
  • One chat flow across OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, and Google models through a Vercel AI SDK provider resolver.
  • Assistant responses streamed over Server-Sent Events, with completed messages persisted.
  • MongoDB/Mongoose storage for conversations, messages, feedback, and scheduled items.
  • Email/password and Google sign-in; JWT access + refresh tokens in HTTP-only cookies; bcrypt password hashing.
  • Image, audio, video, and document uploads with MIME allowlists and a 25 MB limit, stored in AWS S3.
  • Selectable documentation contexts; Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query on the client.
  • Planned next: retrieval-augmented indexing of user-provided documents and automated tests.

03 / ML INFERENCE↗
BioPredict+

Models, served responsibly.

Screenshot coming soon

BioPredict

ML inference · Django

An educational Django machine-learning inference application serving pre-trained models for heart-disease, diabetes, and lung-cancer risk exploration.

  • Python
  • Django 5.1
  • scikit-learn
  • NumPy
  • Bootstrap

ENGINEERING FOCUSSafe model integration, validated inference pipelines, Django forms, model compatibility checks, and responsible ML presentation.

Key features +
  • Serves three pre-trained models: Logistic Regression (heart disease), linear SVC (diabetes), and Random Forest (lung cancer).
  • Validated Django forms reject missing or out-of-range inputs instead of silently treating them as zero.
  • Feature order is checked against each model’s stored feature names on load; models are cached per process.
  • Confidence is shown only where predict_proba() is supported; global feature importance only where it is meaningful.
  • Tests for feature order, predictions, validation, and rendering; documented model and preprocessing caveats.
  • Educational model-serving project. Outputs are model predictions, not medical diagnoses.

04 / NEWS ANALYTICS↗
NotiLytics>

Beyond the headline.

Screenshot coming soon

NotiLytics

Reactive Java

A reactive Java news analytics application combining real-time news retrieval with sentiment analysis, readability metrics, word statistics, source exploration, and session-based search history.

  • Java 17
  • Play Framework 3
  • CompletableFuture
  • News API
  • JUnit
  • Mockito

ENGINEERING FOCUSReactive Java programming, asynchronous API integration, text analytics, MVC architecture, dependency injection, and testing.

Key features +
  • Keyword news search with sorting through Play WS and the News API, composed asynchronously with CompletableFuture.
  • Lexicon-based sentiment plus Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, per article and across results.
  • Word-frequency statistics over search results.
  • News source directory and source profile pages rendered with Scala templates.
  • Session search history of up to 10 queries.
  • Guice-injected service layer; JUnit, Mockito, and AssertJ tests with a mocked API; JaCoCo coverage reporting.

01

Physical Research Laboratory (PRL)

Final Year Project Intern

Python automation for astronomical observation workflows.

  • Built Python automation for the Low Resolution Spectrograph (LRS) and Filter Observation Control (FOC) workflows: telescope pointing, CCD exposures, spectrograph setup, and argon, halogen, and dark calibration sequences.
  • Created Tkinter control interfaces with strict validation of filters, exposures, frames, and observation sequences, and used PyAutoGUI to drive AstroArt and MaxIm DL, which offered no programmatic interface.
  • Implemented bright-star selection and cone-search routines with Astropy, NumPy, and Pandas to choose reference stars for pointing, focusing, and calibration.
  • Validated the software remotely from Ahmedabad and on-site at Mt. Abu Observatory’s 2.5 m telescope, including night-time sessions with research astronomers.
  • Python

  • PyAutoGUI
  • Astropy
  • NumPy
  • Pandas
